Game Overview

In My Sugar Factory, the core idea is straightforward: build a sweet empire from scratch in My Sugar Factory. Start with a tap, expand with factories and labs, and innovate new sugarcane varieties to maximize profits. Enjoy strategic turn-based management and earn even while idle, all wrapped in charming pixel art. Every decision matters on your sugary journey!
